blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 MANILA, Philippines —Juliana Gomez is tempering her expectations for her Asian Games debut but vows to give her all for the Philippines in the Aichi-Nagoya fencing tournament from September 22 to 27. Gomez will compete in the women’s individual epee and team events for Team Philippines, where she expects to face some of Asia’s top fencers. “As much as we want the gold medal, and as much as we want the podium finish for the team, there’s no denying that the Asian zone in fencing, especially if arguably the […]...
